description: On the morning of June 24th, I caught a very early morning flight from Portland to D.C. for work. By 9AM, I had settled into my hotel to catch my breath and prep for a busy day of meetings, but only an hour later everything changed—the Supreme Court released its opinion in Dobbs, undoing decades of precedent and putting women’s rights in jeopardy all over our country.
paid_for_by: Paid for by David Paige for New Hampshire
title: Joint Statement following the repeal of Roe v. Wade - David For NH
